title: Qingxiao/Voicelines
wikitext:
{{Resonator Tabs}} {{Language Tabs}} ==About Voicelines== {{VO |character = Qingxiao |language = en |vo_01_01_title = Thoughts: I |vo_01_01_file = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg |vo_01_01_tx = Centuries have passed since I last journeyed the land of {{Extra Effect|Huanglong|Huanglong|Located at the edge of the continent, this country borders the sea to the east. It boasts a vast territory with one capital and six major cities.}}. Much must have changed. Once matters here are settled, I intend to travel again—perhaps to distant realms, or the places you have been since you awakened. They say a certain Blessed Maiden of {{Extra Effect|Rinascita|Rinascita|A nation of independent city-states scattered across a vast archipelago, with no central administrative center. It is also known as the "Land of Echoes," which boasts unique natural and cultural landscapes.
Legends speak of how Rinascita's founders fled their homelands and sailed to these islands to escape the Lament.}} learned her swordcraft from the tides. If I could meet her, I imagine I would return with a great deal to reflect upon. |vo_01_02_title = Thoughts: II |vo_01_02_intimacy = 1 |vo_01_02_file = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg |vo_01_02_tx = I play the qin to temper my Sword Intent, which is one with the mind. Thus, my deepest thoughts are woven into the melody. I never expected anyone to discern them—until you. A true kindred spirit is rare to find. When the skies are clear and the moon shines bright, I shall play for you again. |vo_01_03_title = Thoughts: III |vo_01_03_intimacy = 2 |vo_01_03_file = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg |vo_01_03_tx = When Xuanfang Hold was besieged, I arrived late, only to find you still fighting upon ravaged land. In that moment, I stood in your position during the Fortress and Gorges War, and you, in mine. I finally understood what you felt back then. From then until now, you have always given everything for a future that was never certain. Even if we only hold back the tide for a single moment... it is never wasted. |vo_01_04_title = Thoughts: IV |vo_01_04_intimacy = 3 |vo_01_04_file = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg |vo_01_04_tx = Recognize this stance? Yes, it is the one I always used before I sought the path of cultivation, the very reason I first took up the sword. Our next duel will not be a contest of Fortes, but of swordplay and clarity of mind. The loser shall sweep every fallen leaf from the training hall's gates. Now, my disciple... receive this strike. |vo_01_05_title = Thoughts: V |vo_01_05_intimacy = 4 |vo_01_05_file = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg |vo_01_05_tx = Disciple, I know {{Extra Effect|Xuanfang|Land of Xuanfang|A region located between Mengzhou and Jinzhou. It is considered a vital passage way between the two cities, and also once a strategic hold for intercepting Tacet Discords.}} is merely a fleeting stop on your long journey, and the day you depart will come. The time we shared here has been precious. Months, years—perhaps a century, as before—may pass before we meet again. Well... I know not when that day will come. Only that it shall. When it does, we need only tell our journeys through our swords. A single clash of our Sword Intent will say more than a thousand words ever could. |vo_02_01_title = Qingxiao's Hobby |vo_02_01_file = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg |vo_02_01_tx = Outside of cultivation, I often spend time setting down my memories and reflections. And since mastering the art of Midair Calligraphy, I rarely use paper and ink. Instead, I channel my Sword Energy to carve the past into my {{Extra Effect|inner landscape|Inner Landscape|An inner world that only a small number of cultivators can enter during deep meditation, where every blade of grass and every tree is a projection of the mind.
This mirage realm is also known by the more common name "Mindscape."}}. What is etched there endures. Everything fades in time, like morning mist, but as long as someone remembers, they never truly vanish. |vo_02_02_title = Qingxiao's Trouble |vo_02_02_file = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg |vo_02_02_tx = These horns emerged alongside my Forte. They have been this way for a century. But lately, they seem to be growing. Another few inches and I may find it... difficult to adapt. Perhaps I could use my sword to trim... No, never mind. |vo_02_03_title = Favorite Food |vo_02_03_file = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg |vo_02_03_tx = I have no preference for food. Cultivation demands we suppress such worldly desires, and I often fast for years at a time. Yet, if anything ever left an impression, it was the meal I had at Yuan's Flavors during a Waking Moon Festival in {{Extra Effect|Yuan Fortress|Yuan Fortress|Prior to the founding of Xuanfang Hold, Yuan Fortress, a mechanized fortress, was built through collaboration between Zhuojun Atelier and the Ministry of Development. It was designed to defend against the Tacet Discord Outbreak originating from the Norfall Barrens.}}. While the Fortress has long since fallen, those flavors live on. |vo_02_04_title = Disliked Food |vo_02_04_file = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg |vo_02_04_tx = Chongzhou cuisine is heavily seasoned and spicy, something I have never quite grown accustomed to. Hsin learned of this one day and secretly added Chongzhou chili sauce to some pastries she had me try. I kept my composure at the time, but I did drink a great deal of tea afterward... |vo_02_05_title = Ideals |vo_02_05_file = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg |vo_02_05_tx = To attain the Way and transcend...? That is the peak most Cultivators strive for. I was no different, once. Yet the Way is boundless. Scale one great mountain, and another waits beyond it. We are all but travelers on this path. Some have merely walked a little further than others. Now, I hone my sword and my spirit for one reason alone... inner peace. |vo_03_01_title = Chat: I |vo_03_01_file = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg |vo_03_01_tx = When I first studied under my master, I struggled to quiet my mind. Instead of telling her, I began wearing silk ribbons said to possess calming properties. They worked. As my training progressed, I removed them one by one, leaving only the ribbon on my left wrist. Later, I learned Master had known all along. She told me the ribbons held no special power. It was the faith I placed in them that granted me confidence and fewer stray thoughts. I still wear it now as a reminder that cultivation is, above all, about being true. |vo_03_02_title = Chat: II |vo_03_02_file = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg |vo_03_02_tx = During these years in {{Extra Effect|Xuanfang}}, I would occasionally descend the mountain to aid the locals. Over time, rumors about me spread. Most are wildly exaggerated. Some revere me as a Transcendent, lighting incense as an offering to me in their homes, while others view the Xuan Paragon as all-powerful. I denied them at first, but eventually, I just let them be. After all, the belief that a Transcendent watches over Xuanfang brings people the comfort they need. |vo_04_01_title = About [[Hsin]] |vo_04_01_intimacy = 1 |vo_04_01_file = {character}{language} About Hsin.ogg |vo_04_01_tx = Hsin is one to follow Her whims, and carries a wealth of emotions unlike any other {{Extra Effect|Sentinel|Sentinel|Wherever there is civilization and history, there will be Sentinels. They serve as mankind's guardians and conductors. Their immortal existence has helped humanity through countless troubles, sharing wisdom and prophecies. As humanity embarks on a new journey after enduring the Lament, the Sentinels remain as the record keeper and beacon in times of disaster.}} of {{Extra Effect|Huanglong}}. It was She who first invited me to hold the honorary title of Xuan Paragon in Xuanfang Hold. In those days, She would often come up the mountain, regaling me with anecdotes and trivia, and once She started, She could go on for hours. Only when I played the qin would She fall quiet. Sometimes, as She listened, a flicker of loneliness would cross Her face… She always believed She hid it well from me. |vo_04_01_mention = Hsin |vo_04_02_title = About [[Changli]] |vo_04_02_intimacy = 2 |vo_04_02_file = {character}{language} About Changli.ogg |vo_04_02_tx = The flame she manipulates is indeed a rare and perilous force. My Quietude Art could only ease the burning pain it caused her. To avoid being consumed by it, she had to temper her mind and master the flow of her Forte. The life she had already burned away cannot be restored. But now that she can wield it freely, she should be fine, so long as she respects her limits. That, too, is thanks to you. |vo_04_02_mention = Changli |vo_04_03_title = About [[Yangyang]] |vo_04_03_intimacy = 3 |vo_04_03_file = {character}{language} About Yangyang.ogg |vo_04_03_tx = When I first met her, I thought the Xuanling Bird had returned. She sees right through the ways of the world and hears the unspoken voices of others. Her Sword Intent seems gentle, yet it carries a resilience second to none. Something seems to be pressing behind her, urging her ever onward, toward some distant journey. Perhaps it is not that she resembles the Xuanling Bird... but that the Xuanling Bird resembled her. |vo_04_03_mention = Yangyang |vo_04_04_title = About [[Buling]] |vo_04_04_intimacy = 4 |vo_04_04_file = {character}{language} About Buling.ogg |vo_04_04_tx = That child is remarkably gifted and sharp. She has already mastered the basics of her Thunder Spells, though she rarely shows them off. At first, I tested her rigorously to see the true depths of her potential. Had she dedicated herself to her cultivation, she might well have reached her master's level within a few years. But that path is clearly not for her. The other day, she sent me a glowing knight's sword, calling it a travel souvenir from {{Extra Effect|Rinascita}}. Well... at least she was thinking of me. |vo_04_04_mention = Buling |vo_04_05_title = About [[Jingran]] |vo_04_05_intimacy = 4 |vo_04_05_file = {character}{language} About Jingran.ogg |vo_04_05_tx = Years ago, his master crossed paths with me and casually asked for a divination before venturing into a Mirage Realm. I know only a little of the art, but I obliged regardless... It was an ill omen. Yet he simply grinned and went on. Later, this young man took up his master's mantle, the smile on his face even more defiant. Even if the road ahead is treacherous and life is fleeting, to live unburdened and unbound... I suppose that, too, is a life well lived. |vo_04_05_mention = Jingran |vo_04_06_title = About [[Ruoyun]] |vo_04_06_intimacy = 5 |vo_04_06_file = {character}{language} About Ruoyun.ogg |vo_04_06_tx = Ruoyun was raised by her village, and her every thought was to use Automata Mechanics to give back to them in some way. Even now, much of what you see in the Land of Xuanfang can be traced back to her work. Her late parents named her Ruoyun, hoping she would live as light and free as drifting clouds, but the choice she made in the end carried a weight far from that. And the Sword Transcendent she once sought out... failed to protect her. |vo_04_06_mention = Ruoyun |vo_04_07_title = About [[Jingwei]] |vo_04_07_intimacy = 5 |vo_04_07_file = {character}{language} About Jingwei.ogg |vo_04_07_tx = My master has walked far along the path of the Way. Having severed all mortal ties and transcended karma, she is a true Transcendent in every sense. She was the one who taught me the breathing exercises and the Quietude Art of the qin, though I cannot say I always heeded her lessons. Yes, she is still in good health. If you ever happen to meet her, please pass along my regards. |vo_04_07_mention = Jingwei |vo_05_01_title = Birthday Wishes |vo_05_01_file = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg |vo_05_01_tx = Today is your birthday. Come, sit. Let me play a piece for you. You are always rushing about for the sake of this world, with scarcely a moment to yourself. Now, rest a while. That bowl on the table? Yes, longevity noodles. I kneaded the dough myself and cut the strands with my flying swords... It was my first attempt, so I cannot vouch for the taste. Why don't you try them first? My disciple, there is no spell in this world that can grant blessings. But from the bottom of my heart, I wish that in all your long years, every path opens before you, and every hope finds its home. |vo_06_01_title = Idle: I |vo_06_01_file = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg |vo_06_01_tx = (Effort sound) |vo_06_02_title = Idle: II |vo_06_02_file = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg |vo_06_02_tx = Mirage into mist, mist into bone... Withdraw. |vo_06_03_title = Idle: III |vo_06_03_file = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg |vo_06_03_tx = (Effort sound) |vo_07_01_title = Self-Introduction |vo_07_01_file = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg |vo_07_01_tx = Xuan Paragon, Qingxiao, a seeker of the Way. Time's endless flow has brought you back to me. Take up your blade, and let us walk this path together. |vo_07_02_title = Greeting |vo_07_02_file = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg |vo_07_02_tx = On the qin strings do eons sing, eternal peace my blade shall bring. |vo_08_01_title = Join Team: I |vo_08_01_file = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg |vo_08_01_tx = Let us walk together once more. |vo_08_02_title = Join Team: II |vo_08_02_file = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg |vo_08_02_tx = The road ahead is unclear. Stay close. |vo_08_03_title = Join Team: III |vo_08_03_file = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg |vo_08_03_tx = How about a melody before we depart? |vo_09_01_title = Ascension: I |vo_09_01_ascension = 1 |vo_09_01_file = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg |vo_09_01_tx = Cultivation takes time. Practice daily, and progress will follow. |vo_09_02_title = Ascension: II |vo_09_02_ascension = 2 |vo_09_02_file = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg |vo_09_02_tx = This Sword Intent has bound us together. Let this strength stay with you, in return for all you have given me. |vo_09_03_title = Ascension: III |vo_09_03_ascension = 3 |vo_09_03_file = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg |vo_09_03_tx = My Heart Lake has grown clearer... With you beside me, I no longer fear the tangled shadows of my own heart. |vo_09_04_title = Ascension: IV |vo_09_04_ascension = 4 |vo_09_04_file = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg |vo_09_04_tx = They say a master need not outshine their student. Even so, I've learned far more from you than I ever taught. Tell me, my disciple... how shall I make it up to you? |vo_09_05_title = Ascension: V |vo_09_05_ascension = 5 |vo_09_05_file = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg |vo_09_05_tx = I once roamed the world believing my swordcraft was without equal. Divine, even. How shallow I was. The sky has no ceiling, and the way of the sword knows no limit. Swordcraft is only ever divine when it guards what we hold dear, and those we love. My disciple... should anyone dare harm you, they will answer to my sword first. }} ==Combat== {{Combat VO |character = Qingxiao |language = en |basic_1_tx = Glimmer. |basic_2_tx = Breach. |basic_3_tx = Sunder. |basic_4_tx = I am the blade. |basic_5_tx = Split into lights. |basic_6_tx = Annihilate. |basic_7_tx = Evil, purge. |heavy_1_tx = Focus the mind. |heavy_2_tx = One with the sword. |heavy_3_tx = A quick end to you. |heavy_4_tx = Shattering tunes, rising steel. |heavy_5_tx = Pure lights, shake the sky. |heavy_6_tx = How many strikes can you survive? |aerial_1_tx = Windstorm. |aerial_2_tx = Cloudburst. |aerial_3_tx = Cleave the fog. |aerial_4_tx = Pierce the sky. |resskill_1_tx = Chase the stars. |resskill_2_tx = Rule the wind. |resskill_3_tx = Ride on the blade. |resskill_4_tx = Empyreal verdict. |resskill_5_tx = Heaven descends. |resskill_6_tx = Traverse. |resskill_7_tx = Disperse. |resliberation_1_tx = Chords, cleanse the filth. |resliberation_2_tx = Swords, purge the realm. |resliberation_3_tx = All my will, in one strike. |introoutro_1_tx = Purged by my hand. |introoutro_2_tx = Change of mode. |dodge_1_tx = Predictable. |counter_1_tx = Neutralize. |counter_2_tx = Negate. |dodgecounter_1_tx = My turn. |dodgecounter_2_tx = ...Silence. |hit_1_tx = My fault. |injured_1_tx = Adapt and overcome. |injured_2_tx = Worry not...
